name: project-review-workspace
description: Workspace: pure domain core, Svelte component library, and the single-page app that derives a full project-review slideshow from one portfolio file.
author: François Cabouat

scripts.build: cd app && node --run build && cd .. && node scripts/build-notices.ts
scripts.check: cd packages/core && node --run check && cd ../components && node --run check && cd ../infrastructure && node --run check && cd ../../app && node --run check
scripts.test: node --test app/tests-smoke/server.test.mjs scripts/gitflow.test.mjs scripts/gitflow-client.test.mjs scripts/release.test.mjs scripts/version.test.mjs && vitest run
scripts.test:coverage: node --test app/tests-smoke/server.test.mjs scripts/gitflow.test.mjs scripts/gitflow-client.test.mjs scripts/release.test.mjs scripts/version.test.mjs && vitest run --coverage
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run check && pnpm run knip && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run build && pnpm run smoke && pnpm run docs:api && pnpm run build-storybook && pnpm run docs:examples && pnpm run docs:site && pnpm run a11y
